# Savings memo

Switching to the recommended internet and phone plans saves you an estimated $3,274.36 over 24 months.

## Internet

**Recommended: Fiberly Fiber 500** (offer id `int-fiberly-500`), $65/mo with autopay ($60/mo net), no contract, 36-month price lock, $99 one-time installation.

Why it is eligible:
- Typical download 520 Mbps (minimum 500), upload 500 Mbps (minimum 20). Speeds are typical, not "up to".
- No data cap. Your highest month was 1,452 GB download (July 2026), and this plan has no cap.
- No contract, and available in your area (ZIP3 951).

Cost: **$819.00 over 12 months** and **$1,539.00 over 24 months**.

Runner-up: Fiberly Fiber 1 Gig (`int-fiberly-1g`), eligible and available. Cost $999.00 over 12 months and $1,899.00 over 24 months. It is $360 more over two years for speeds you don't need.

Rejected:
- Bayline Connect 600 (`int-bayline-connect-600`, Sponsored): 1,229 GB data cap, below your 1,452 GB peak.
- Bayline Performance 500 (`int-bayline-perf-500`): 10 Mbps upload, below the 20 Mbps minimum.
- Bayline Gigabit Loyalty (`int-bayline-gig-loyalty`, Sponsored): eligible, but $2,148.00 over 24 months, which is more than Fiberly 500.
- SkyLink Home 5G (`int-skylink-home-5g`, Sponsored): typical download 415 Mbps, below the 500 Mbps minimum.
- Sonic Wave Wave 1G (`int-sonic-wave-1g`): 12-month contract, and you don't want contracts.
- Hill Country Max 500 (`int-hillcountry-cable-500`, Sponsored), MetroNet Fiber 500 (`int-metronet-500`), Lonestar Fiber 1 Gig (`int-lonestar-fiber-1g`): not sold in your area.

## Phones

**Recommended: Orbit Mobile Essentials Unlimited** (offer id `mob-orbit-essentials`), 3 lines at $25/line ($75/mo) plus $9/mo taxes, no contract, numbers kept.

Why it is eligible:
- Unlimited data on every line. Your highest use is 41.0 GB on line A.
- Hotspot is 20 GB per line. Line A's highest hotspot month was 16.4 GB (July 2026), so it fits.
- Roaming: Mexico is not included, but a day pass is $10/day. Arjun's roughly 10 travel days a year (two trips of about 5 days) cost $100/year in day passes, which is included in the totals below.
- Available in your area.

Cost: **$1,108.00 over 12 months** and **$2,216.00 over 24 months**.

Runner-up: Northstar Unlimited Max (`mob-northstar-max`), eligible and available. 3 lines at $120/mo minus $15 autopay, $0 taxes, Mexico included, 50 GB hotspot. Cost $1,260.00 over 12 months and $2,520.00 over 24 months, which is $304 more than Orbit.

Rejected:
- Carrierco Unlimited Welcome (`mob-carrierco-welcome`, Sponsored): 5 GB hotspot per line, below line A's 16.4 GB peak.
- Pebble Mobile Unlimited (`mob-pebble-unlimited`): 10 GB hotspot per line, below line A's peak.
- Tandem Flex Shared 60 (`mob-tandem-flex-60`): hotspot uses the shared 60 GB pool. Combined use in June and July 2026 was about 67.7 GB and 71.0 GB, which is above 60 GB.
- Volt Mobile Volt 15 (`mob-volt-15`, Sponsored): 15 GB data per line, below line A's 41.0 GB peak.
